passingCriteria: Total score of 60 or higher (automatic fail if any subject is below 40%)
difficulty: Entry to intermediate · Even first-time SQL learners can prepare in 8 weeks
prerequisites: There are no eligibility requirements to take the exam.

faq.q: How is the SQLD exam administered?
faq.a: You answer 50 multiple-choice questions in 90 minutes. Subject 1, Understanding Data Modeling, has 10 questions (20 points), and Subject 2, SQL Fundamentals and Application, has 40 questions (80 points), at 2 points per question.
A total score of 60 or higher passes. However, scoring below 40% in any subject is an automatic fail, so you must score above 8 of 20 points in Subject 1 and above 32 of 80 points in Subject 2.
No. Anyone can take the exam.

faq.q: How many times a year is the exam held?
faq.a: It is held regularly four times a year. The exam fee is KRW 50,000, and you can check the registration period for each session on the registration page of the Korea Data Agency's data certification website.

faq.q: Which DBMS syntax do the questions use?
faq.a: Oracle syntax is the baseline, and some questions ask about differences from SQL Server (such as TOP and the + string concatenation operator). That is why the example results in these notes were verified by running them on a real Oracle database.
